name: SolEnrich
description: Agent-native onchain intelligence for Solana. StonkFun reward coins: gem finder, payout status and alerts, holder yield for one coin or 25, trade cost and payback, and launch intel per quote asset. Plus wallet risk scoring, token due-diligence and rug detection, smart-money tracking across spot, perps, and fresh launches, cross-venue perps funding, and LLM-ready briefings. 47 paid endpoints plus 1 free, per-call USDC via x402 on Solana or Base. Operated by Parallax Labs.
